en.topic_title: Taiwan says closes representative office in Papua New Guinea, blames China
en.topic_summary:
Taiwan said Friday it has decided to close its representative office in Papua New Guinea and withdraw its staff, blaming Chinese coercion of the South Pacific nation for the decision.
